'''Vobin Sobos''' was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The pirate band Sobos was part of once worked for the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]]. However, Rystra captured Sobos and some of the other pirates and took them back to the [[Temple of Pain]], a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] built inside an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], located inside the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]]. Rystra practiced [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] on them and Sobos was scarred by this.
